invariants.invariant: Every external GitHub Action in workflows must be pinned to a 40-character commit SHA.
invariants.rationale: Prevents supply chain attacks and unexpected upstream breaking changes.

invariants.invariant: All skill definitions in .agents/skills/ must have valid frontmatter and non-dangling symlinks.
invariants.rationale: Ensures skill discovery and invocation across multi-agent CLI runtimes work reliably.

invariants.invariant: Markdown links across repository documentation must resolve without breaking.
invariants.rationale: Maintains documentation integrity and prevents dead references.

invariants.invariant: Repository files must adhere to defined line-count limits.
invariants.rationale: Prevents monolithic file bloat and maintains modular code design.

invariants.invariant: ADR records must be registered in plans/_status.json and executable invariants verified.
invariants.rationale: Ensures architectural decisions are tracked and enforced by executable checks.
